summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the Owner Recovery feature. Backend pytest (7/7 passed) covers: recover-owner wrong code -> 401; correct 'recover-john' -> 200 with token+is_owner; admin/config -> recovery_set:true; admin/set-recovery too-short (<6) -> 400; owner-session required (bogus creds -> 401/403); resetting recovery to same value succeeds and remains valid; gate/status regression (enabled:false, has_owner:true). Frontend Playwright tests (4/4 passed): (1) /admin/invites lock screen: entering 'recover-john' in recovery-code-input + clicking recover-owner-btn reveals gate-toggle and generate-btn. (2) After unlock, set-recovery-input + save-recovery-btn with 'recover-john' shows success (no error, page text contains 'saved'/'recovery code'). (3) /invite: show-recover-btn reveals invite-recovery-input; entering 'recover-john' + invite-recover-btn navigates to pac-screen. (4) Root routes to pac-screen; entering 6 digits via pac-key-1..6 loads main app ('Hi John', €3475.00). Recovery code left as 'recover-john' (confirmed via final /api/gate/recover-owner call returning is_owner:true).
